## 1. STATUS

**DRAFT r16 (final).** Objective: a configured server whose durable binding is `retired:true` is a deliberate operator re-add — every committed admission (startup or reload) reinstates it with no retired-era residue through any admission the bridge controls, exactly one bounded warn record per reinstated server at commit, and a durability contract that is fail-closed BEFORE the snapshot rename and honestly uncertain after it; tombstones for servers no longer configured keep current semantics.

## 2. REQUIREMENTS
<!-- specdd:requirements:start -->

**R9 (ticket 02 / #11; owner decision 2026-11-27; trust model narrowed at r6; durability narrowed at r13).** A server present in the current configuration whose retained durable binding is retired MUST be reinstated at admission: tombstone cleared, binding carries the **current configured endpoint fingerprint** (EQUAL to the retired fingerprint in the live incident shape, or the new one after an endpoint change), server admitted **without any retired-era state** — no tools, embeddings, health success, or stale prompt rows of the retired era survive on this start or through any later admission **the bridge controls**. "Without any retired-era state": STARTUP — empty catalog until the first successful probe; RELOAD — no retired-era rows, **zero prompt rows at …

## 4. DESIGN
<!-- specdd:design:start -->

**Q1 — where the reinstatement lives.** Rewrite `internal/storage/reconcile.go:80-81` mirroring `:93-99`: `purged[binding.ServerID] = true` + `Binding{ServerID, EndpointFingerprint: server.EndpointFingerprint}` — **unconditional on fingerprint equality, so the incident's EQUAL-fingerprint shape takes this path (the predicate is the retirement state, NOT the fingerprint — CR3)**. `Reconcile` stays pure; `:82-91` untouched. F4 comment updates: `:35-40`, `reconcile_test.go:15`/`:174-175`, `durable_test.go:210-211`/`:250-251`.

**Q2 — the warn seam.** In `build`: **hoist `base := in.reconcileBase(previous)` ABOVE `:537`**; `pending := pendingReinstatement(base, in.candidate.Servers)` gates the prompt-load block's ADR10/ADR13 fail-closed checks; after `:681-683`, `reinstated := reinstatedServers(base, snapshot, configured)` (≡ `pending`) and the ADR9(a) purge; at the commit point (after `:750`), for each reinstated id in sorted order (PER SERVER — one Entry each, r16/M3), if `in.deps.Logger != nil && in.mode != buildRefresh`, one `observe.Entry{Level: "warn", Event: "binding_reinstated", Operation: in.mode.String(), Outcome: "degraded", Server: id}` — via the mutex-serialized `Logger.write` (`log.go:176-179`), inside `commitMu` (`:718-719`).

**Q3 — purge proof.** (i) health row reset/stamped (`:119`, `:111-127`; `StampServerEmpty` `:225-232`; fresh on successful-discovery reload); (ii) tools dropped (`:129-139`); (iii) embeddings transitively (`:140-149`); (iv) `definitionsFromSnapshot` restores nothing retired (`:817`; startup-arm only); (v) prompts: ADR9(a) both modes (zero committed rows for each reinstated server), durable-before-snapshot with fail-closed branches and the disclosed pre-rename residue; (vi) query cache: none durable (snapshot.go:102), per-generation in process; (vii) two guarantees (r11/C5, r12/CR11-04): the validated retired-input constraint (`snapshot.go:313-315`/`:330-336` + guard `:46-50` — **the incident snapshot validates: zero rows for all 15 retired ids**) vs the `pur…

**Q4 — fingerprint.** The binding carries the CURRENT configured fingerprint — equal to the retired one in the incident shape; fixtures cover BOTH sub-cases (equal: `BindingAllowed(id, sameFp)` true; distinct: `BindingAllowed(id, oldFp)` false, scoped to that sub-case). Unconditional on equality (ADR5).

**Q5 — interactions.** Rebind `:82-87` unchanged; `Validate` unchanged; schema-1 decode-agnostic (`toCanonical` `:109`; compat fixtures carry no retired binding — the decode fixture is the gated follow-up, recorded not blocking — r15/CR7); unconfigured tombstones `:90-91`; the drop→re-add reload reaches the branch (`:791-796` base; fresh client `:584-597`).

**Q6 — nothing else becomes lenient.** Exactly one switch case changes. Corrupt snapshots fail closed (`:46-50`); admission failures reject (`loop.go:157-160`); unconfigured tombstones never reinstate; pre-rename failures fail closed; post-rename uncertainty per ADR15. Concurrency: immutable reads; `commitMu` + Logger lock; `-race` fixtures.

**Event/contract wiring (r6 ruling 2; r9/CR8-01; r16/M1).** `eventMessage` case; canonical pin `"binding_reinstated": "startup"`; maps + pin 36→37 (`:777-778`); docs: `:549` byte-identical FIRST, variant rows APPENDED, `:76` pin-row UPDATED, `:562-563` updated; the `binding_reinstated` row documents both operations + `—` error cells; **the containment test (in the granted `logging_contract_test.go`) asserts ALL FOUR docs elements and is AC25's oracle — no separate AC**.

<!-- specdd:design:end -->
